title: Finishing a workout and earning a PR
question: What happens when I confirm Finish, and how does a personal record show up on Home, History and Progress?

actors.role: The Finish workout? dialog; its Finish button calls the screen's finish().
Asks WorkoutService to finish, refreshes the app and opens the workout detail.
Completes the workout, and later builds summaries with PR counts for the screens.
Saves finished workouts, clears the active one and lists history newest first.
Versioned read, write and remove on localStorage.

actors.label: Browser localStorage
actors.role: Holds the workouts list and the activeWorkout key.
refresh() bumps a version so every screen re-reads the services.
The /history/:id page shown right after finishing, with PR badges.
Finds the sets in one workout that beat every earlier finished workout.
Shows streak, this week and the last workout with its PR count.
Lists every finished workout with its PR count.
Shows an exercise's best-set chart and its record list.
Reads all workouts and asks the domain for records and the best-set series.
Heaviest weight, best estimated 1RM, most reps and best set volume for one exercise.

steps.say: The lifter taps Finish in the Finish workout? dialog. Its onConfirm runs finish() in src/ui/screens/ActiveWorkoutScreen.tsx:104.
The screen asks WorkoutService to finish, and the service loads the active workout.
At least one set is ticked, so it goes on. Unticked sets are dropped, empty exercises removed, and finishedAt is stamped.
The finished workout is added to the saved workouts list.
The active workout is cleared, so the app no longer shows one in progress.
The screen gets the finished workout, calls refresh() so other screens re-read, and navigates to its detail page.
The detail page asks the service for the workout and its PR sets. The service reads every saved workout.
PRs are not stored; they are worked out on every read. A set is a PR if it beats earlier workouts on weight, estimated 1RM or reps.
The first time a lift is logged, only its single best set earns the badge.
The detail page shows a PRs tile with the count and a badge on each record set.
Home calls homeSummary(): streak, this week's volume and the last workout card with its PR count.
History calls listHistory(), which summarises each saved workout with its own PR count.
Progress asks ProgressService for an exercise's records, which reads all workouts and calls personalRecords.
The new best shows in the records list with today's date. Best set volume is computed but not shown.
The lifter taps Finish with no set ticked.
The screen asks the service to finish, and the service loads the active workout.
No done sets: the service throws a ValidationError and saves nothing.
The screen shows the message inside the dialog. The workout stays active.

do.text: Tick at least one set, or discard it.

steps.say: The lifter can Keep lifting, or Discard the workout instead.
Nothing reached localStorage, so Home, History and Progress are unchanged.
